conf.description: Varonis DatAdvantage / DatAlert alert / syslog-cef: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: varonis / alert / syslog-cef. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (elastic/integrations varonis, data stream logs). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
